name: AI Provider: Dropsolid AI
description: Provides Dropsolid AI integration for the Drupal AI module.
project_description: Connects a Drupal site to the Dropsolid AI platform — a managed, OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway — by orchestrating the AI module's existing building blocks rather than shipping its own provider client. It provides a guided setup wizard (a vertical-tab configuration form at /admin/config/ai/providers/dropsolidai) that helps site builders install, configure and live-test the full Dropsolid AI stack: the LiteLLM AI provider (for chat/completions against the Dropsolid gateway), an optional PostgreSQL/PGVector vector database for embeddings and RAG, optional LangFuse tracing/analytics, and Dropsolid-specific AI extras. Each component has an AJAX 'test connection' button that validates the relevant module's configuration and connectivity (reading API keys and passwords from Key entities), and the module records per-component configured/tested status in its own config object. A one-click Dropsolid SSO auto-setup is signposted as coming soon (the SSO callback controller is currently a placeholder). The provider itself is delivered through the required ai_provider_litellm module, which the wizard configures.
